title: Fort Témiscamingue Chief Factor’s House
mappedPositionBasis: The government management plan places the factor’s house near the west shore in the southwestern group. The south-of-forge OSM house ruins match that relationship and show a central house outline plus a narrower north projection. The unnamed feature is an approximate cross-identification.
